baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذِكْرَىٰ ... قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The reminder becomes effective through inward understanding or deliberately directed hearing; witnessed presence converts sound into attended, answerable reception.

activation_trace.role: Reminder as what restores a matter to presence supplies the content offered to reception.
Heart as understanding and spirit supplies the inward faculty that can take the reminder in.
Casting or placing supplies deliberate direction, making hearing an offered faculty rather than an accident.
Hearing as understanding, acceptance, and compliance makes reception exceed acoustic contact.
Presence with observation supplies the attending state in which directed hearing becomes effective.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely says that attentive people benefit from a reminder.
changed_reading.after: It specifies receptive agency: inward understanding or deliberately offered hearing becomes remembrance only in active presence.

baseline_models.mechanism: The clause is a relay for making an absent truth present: recollection retrieves it inwardly, or received speech reaches the inner core, and knowledgeable witness is the resulting manifest stance.

activation_trace.role: Recollection after forgetting or while retaining knowledge supplies the movement from latency to presence.
The pure inner core supplies the destination in which recalled or received meaning is concentrated.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies a latent capacity for reorientation within that core.
Taking and transmitting speech supplies the verbal relay implicit in directing hearing toward a message.
Knowledge-based testimony supplies the endpoint where received meaning can be acknowledged and declared.

changed_reading.before: Heart, hearing, and presence are three static qualities of a receptive person.
changed_reading.after: They form two routes of re-presentation: inward recovery or received speech culminates in a stance able to attest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly cross-pairs reminder, heart-insight, and return: the returning servant of 50:8 becomes the returning heart of 50:33, and 50:37 recombines reminder with heart. The heart is therefore not bare capacity but a core whose operative motion is repeated reorientation.

activation_trace.role: Heart-insight gives the preceding signs an inward perceptual mode, preparing the focus heart as more than an organ.
Reminder as what makes a matter present explicitly links the earlier signs to receptive return.
Habitual return supplies the repeated directional motion of the servant who receives reminder.
Turning from one face to another makes the contextual heart capable of real reorientation.
Habitual return directly qualifies the heart and transfers the return-pattern into the focus clause.
Heart as understanding anchors contextual return back in the focus recipient.

structural_cues: 50:8 joins insight and reminder to a returning servant.
50:33 joins heart to returning; 50:37 joins reminder to heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated pairings; I infer that return names the heart's receptive motion. A live alternative is that returning remains an ethical description of the person, not an inner mechanics claim.

changed_reading.before: Having a heart means possessing a generic faculty of understanding.
changed_reading.after: Having a heart means retaining an inner core able to turn back repeatedly when reminder reaches it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the context, the same root moves through firm placement, active reception, and consequential dispatch. In the focus idiom, casting hearing therefore reads as committing one's receptive faculty toward an encounter, not merely noticing sound.

activation_trace.role: Casting as deliberate placement supplies the materially directed motion used for setting mountains in the earth.
Meeting and reception supply the complementary receiving motion embodied by the two receivers.
Decisive casting toward an outcome shows that the root's directed transfer can commit its object consequentially.
The focus act of casting hearing anchors those placement and transfer images in the listener's agency.

structural_cues: The root sequence runs from placing mountains (50:7), through receiving recorders (50:17), to decisive casting (50:24), before its focus use.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies placement, reception, and dispatch; I infer that the focus idiom retains directed commitment. Alternatively, the construction may be fully conventional and mean only attentive listening without a material-transfer residue.

changed_reading.before: Hearing is a passive channel available to someone without inward insight.
changed_reading.after: The hearer actively places or commits hearing into receptive contact with the reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes chosen listening from unavoidable hearing: every self arrives with a witness, the addressee is commanded to listen, and all later hear the true cry. Focus hearing while witness becomes a present, voluntary advance response before audition turns compulsory and testimonial.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based witness accompanying every self gives the focus presence a possible testimonial horizon.
The command to listen supplies voluntary acoustic attention before the later collective hearing.
Raised voice and call supply the message-event toward which listening is directed.
Collective hearing supplies the unavoidable later counterpart to present chosen listening.
The terrifying cry supplies the terminal sound-event whose truth can no longer be ignored.
Hearing as understanding and compliance anchors the contrast in a response possible before compulsion.
Knowledge-based testimony anchors answerability in the focus phrase 'while witness.'

structural_cues: 50:21 brings every self with a witness.
50:41 commands listening; 50:42 predicts hearing the cry in truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary imperative, later universal hearing, and witness language; I infer a now-versus-then accountability arc. Alternatively, focus 'witness' may denote only mental presence, without judicial force.

changed_reading.before: Being witness means simply concentrating while listening.
changed_reading.after: Present listening is an advance act of acknowledgement before the final call makes hearing and testimony unavoidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The heedlessness-cover-uncovering-sharp-sight sequence makes reminder a voluntary awakening before forced exposure. Heart and offered hearing are present means of lifting inattention; witness is the state opposite being covered over.

activation_trace.role: A lapse that leaves something outside wakefulness supplies the negative state that reminder reverses.
Lifting a covering supplies the forced transition from hiddenness to manifest perception.
A concealing cover supplies the obstruction between latent knowledge and present witness.
Eye-sight supplies the perception that becomes unavoidable after the cover is removed.
A sharp penetrating edge supplies the sudden acuity of exposed sight.
Recollection after forgetting anchors the contextual reversal of heedlessness in the focus reminder.

structural_cues: 50:22 moves causally from heedlessness through removal of a cover to sharp sight; 50:37 offers reminder, heart, and hearing before that forced unveiling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a forced perceptual unveiling; I infer that focus receptivity is its voluntary present analogue. Alternatively, 50:22 may describe only a future state and need not define how present reminder works.

changed_reading.before: Reminder primarily adds information that a recipient lacks.
changed_reading.after: Reminder reactivates covered awareness, offering voluntary presence before perception is forcibly uncovered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command explicitly opposes coercive domination to reminding by recitation. The focus clause supplies the receiving half of that mode: the message is recited and recalled, while response occurs through a turning heart or self-committed hearing.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation identify the voiced discourse that frames the surah's reminder.
Coercion and overpowering supply the mode explicitly denied to the reminder's transmitter.
Reminding as making a matter present supplies the authorized action in place of coercion.
Recitation supplies the audible vehicle by which the closing reminder reaches a hearer.
The heart's capacity to turn supplies an internally enacted response rather than an imposed one.
Deliberately casting hearing supplies the recipient's active contribution to non-coercive communication.

structural_cues: Quranic recitation frames the surah at 50:1 and returns in 50:45.
50:45 places denial of coercion directly before the command to remind by the Quran.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacency of non-compulsion, reminder, and recitation; I infer that 50:37 describes the reciprocal agency this mode requires. Alternatively, denial of compulsion may concern authority generally, while the receptivity clause independently classifies its audience.

changed_reading.before: The focus clause only identifies which audience is capable of benefiting.
changed_reading.after: It also protects the reminder's non-coercive economy: recitation offers, while heart-turning or committed hearing supplies the response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the immediate transition spatially; it remains anchored because 50:36 combines travel, probing interiors, and failed deviation immediately before the focus inner core. Render it only as a discourse-level reversal, not as an etymology of qalb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَلْبٌ as the inner core after 50:36's outward probing and failed search for escape

activation_trace.role: Travel and probing through lands supply the exhausted outward search immediately before the focus.
Searching interiors and reports supplies an externalized attempt to penetrate what is hidden.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the escape that outward search fails to find.
The pure inner core supplies the inward site to which the discourse redirects attention.
Understanding and compliance supply a receptive alternative to futile spatial penetration.

changed_reading.before: 50:36's failed search and 50:37's receptive faculties are adjacent but unrelated.
changed_reading.after: The discourse pivots from penetrating the world for an exit to opening the inner core or hearing to reminder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the tree-pith branch of qalb through the earlier growth sequence; it remains anchored in the packet's focus branch and in 50:8's labeling of those signs as reminder. Render it as a material analogy for receptivity, not as the lexical sense of qalb in 50:37.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَلْبٌ through the branch image of a tree's tender inner core

activation_trace.role: Planting and causing growth supply the generative process that begins the material analogy.
The explicit reminder label ties the preceding created landscape to the focus function of remembrance.
A seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies a compact image of latent response becoming visible fruit.
Earth revived by rain and growth supplies the transition from dormant receptivity to life.
The tender core of palm or tree anchors the growth analogy directly in the focus word heart.

changed_reading.before: The heart is only an abstract cognitive container for reminder.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, reminder is germinative input reaching a living inner pith, so receptivity resembles cultivation and revival.

strongest_changes: The 50:8/50:33 lexical chain made the heart a repeatedly returning core, not a generic intellect.
The 50:21/50:41-42 sequence made chosen listening an advance witness before unavoidable hearing.
The 50:45 close made 50:37 the recipient-side mechanics of non-coercive Quranic reminder.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly redistributed the focus roots across paired scenes: reminder with return, casting with receiving, present hearing with final hearing, and recitation with denied coercion. Those recurrences turned a static aptitude list into a temporal and reciprocal mechanism.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether أَوْ marks genuinely alternative routes or two facets of one receptive event.
Whether شَهِيدٌ carries a judicial/testimonial horizon here or only attentive presence.
How much material residue remains live in casting hearing; the placement and germination models should remain qualified.
